Here's my current take on the agenda:

* Testing Update
   * Fuzzing findings
* Client Update
   * Clients should re-base Osaka-0 EOF on top of Pectra-5 requirements
* Compiler Updates
* Spec And Other Issues
  * EOF Metadata Section
  * EOFCREATE hashing 
  * Cross chain addresses (determinstic, counterfactual, and noceless)
     * Pre-ERC on standard conrtracts
  * Start work on Osaka-1 spec changes
  * Tempurture check on timelines and scenarios

To expand on the topic "EOFCREATE hashing + Cross chain addresses) We've put together a short doc which tries to gather the potential features and scenarios for a more general discussion on that subject: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ipsilon/SyrzctZSJg

I'm not sure if everyone will have time to familiarize with it before today's call, but I'd like to quickly showcase the doc and ask to prepare for discussion in 2 weeks.

Cannot join the meeting today but have some update on Solidity EOF support state. 
We have implemented all required features to make compilation to EOF possible. It can be now used to compile solidity contracts to EOF. There are a couple of PRs still to be merged but there are only tests enabling and updating. I can confirm that all solidity tests pass.

Still a lot of minor things remain to be implemented. Everything listed [here](https://github.com/ethereum/solidity/issues/15310) 

The most important IMO is to re-enable optimizations for EOF which removes code size regression.
